name: archreator
description: The archreator method: enterprise-architecture-first development for organizations and applications, built directly from your request and validated when you confirm it.

plugins.name: archreator
plugins.description: Enterprise-architecture-first development: model an organization or an application through numbered ArchiMate layers, build directly from the request, and record it in a scope document. The agent stops only for a contradiction, an ambiguity, or something needing authorization, shows you what the change claims in the conversation, and your confirmation is what validates it.
